head_commit.message:
perf(cab): reduce worker contention and prepare larger modeled blocks

Preserve JUCE partition geometry while extending prepared modeled convolution
through 512 samples, avoiding per-kernel loader threads. Start the IR worker
at low priority and observe worker/caller scheduling outside measured callbacks.
Cache fixed cone geometry without changing the authored arithmetic order.

Local frozen-source validation: 10/10 CTests and 66/66 strict p99 conditions;
34/105600 individual misses retained. Independent exact-bit cone references,
144 convolution routes and eight direct six-mic cases pass. Separate diagnostic
profile has 12/12 p99 passes with all seven misses and regressions recorded.
Full native product/Candidate and installer acceptance remain required.

record.profile_limit: Each is one later instrumented run, not ABBA or acceptance. Stage totals are wall-clock per-callback aggregates with nested scopes; quantiles are independent across stages and not callback-index paired. Worker totals cover worker lifetime including untimed setup/convergence.
record.clock_limit: 288000 native CPU deltas are paired with the same callback. The CPU clock brackets more than the original wall gate, and measurement overhead is not calibrated; small CPU deadline margins cannot be assigned wholly to DSP.
record.lifecycle_limit: Both latest_six_mics converged within existing unchanged iteration limits; exact latest-convergence time is not logged. stop_us is one diagnostic observation per variant, not a starvation/latency bound.

assembly_correction.finding: SIMD candidate still contains generated overlap/vectorization tail paths; it does not eliminate all loop-versioning code. Explicit main loop also contains individual LDUR/LDR and extra address additions. Static instruction counts are not dynamic execution counts or a runtime causal attribution.

interpretation_limits: ABBA used one sequential A1/B2/B3/A4 sequence on one native VM. Reference focal p99 itself varied from 153.667 to 299.625 us. No statistical significance or isolated instruction-cost attribution is claimed.
B2 focal p99 333.875 us exceeds the unchanged 333.333333333 us budget by 0.541667 us; B3 369.625 us exceeds it by 36.291667 us. Both remain failures.

51 of 53 focal B wall misses also have same-callback CPU above the budget. CPU clocks bracket a wider interval than wall, with uncalibrated measurement overhead; small margins cannot be assigned to DSP alone.
All 140 misses across four ABBA and two separate profiles occur in worker/automation; forced phase has zero. Existing modulo8 sleep association is not causal proof.
Separate profiles have additional nested instrumentation. Stage quantiles cannot be added or paired to the same wall-p99 callback; worker lifetime wall totals are not callback-aligned CPU.
Both native correctness suites passed, including B 1,705,864 scalar-oracle float comparisons. Correctness does not establish timing acceptance.
